name: std::basic_string_view<CharT,Traits>::back
intro: Returns reference to the last character in the view. The behavior is undefined if empty() == true.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Reference to the last character, equivalent to operator[](size() - 1).

examples.output:
F ABCDEF
E ABCDE
D ABCD
C ABC
B AB
A A
